superseded_attempts.reason: PM callers and JSON parser accepted 128 KiB, but the shared regular-file reader still rejected a requested maximum above 64 KiB. Raised the reader ceiling while preserving all other callers limits and boundary tests.

source_sync.timing: Delta hashes verified before final documentation updates; runtime/build sources match the tested archive.

production_source_comparison.interpretation: All executable/config/build sources match the cloud artifact; only listed prior user extensions differ. Later documentation does not change these runtime sources.

visual_review.method: Eight original artifact PNGs viewed with view_image; file hashes bind the previews to final artifact copies.
observations: GMI slot labels, raw words, offsets and unverified units are legible.
DIMM screenshot shows a scrolled section: DIMM_POWER slots 16..23 and DIMM_TEMP slots 0..11; it does not visually cover all 48 rows. All row values are checked by the Qt regression.
All eight PCIe stored rows are visible, including four separate bandwidth slots.
The error view shows DIMM_TEMP slot 0 as unavailable with 0x7f800001 while neighboring values remain readable.
No clipped labels or overlapping controls/status text observed at 1150x940. Synthetic data only.

limits: 92 original array storage words are recovered. Units, active policy meaning, physical target identity and real hardware behavior remain unverified.
Existing core/CCD offset mismatches remain research questions. No per-core PM layout, SVI power guess, firmware target binding or new setting is enabled.
EL7 target is Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64; other RHEL/CentOS 7 configurations have not been certified.
No real hardware register settings or Secure Boot enrollment were tested; QEMU validates module integration only.
Windows/macOS test portable core only. Remaining AMD controls, other Intel models and board-specific controls are incomplete.

findings: The seven-function array study and five-function monitor follow-up both succeeded; get_pm_patch appears in both, giving eleven distinct original functions in this batch.
All twelve query entries were mapped from exact file offsets to Ghidra addresses at +0x100000, then checked against ELF symbols and reported body ranges.
The two amd_bycore UI candidates collect QLineEdit pointers and parse tuning inputs. Equal member offsets in a different object do not establish PM array display bindings.
Reader_Thread::pm_monitor calls get_pm with ESI=4; amd_am3 and amd_am4 monitors call it with ESI=1 then ESI=4. The returned pseudocode omits these mode arguments.
Update2_fast instructions select 0x2b0 or 0x320 as initial read offsets, but its pseudocode omits the MMIO offset argument. This fast path is not proof of the exact Shimada per-core layout.

New GMI/DIMM/PCIe decoding is based on independent original-instruction replay of the common path. UI research does not certify units, physical slot identity, actual population or native firmware access.

Mode 4 observed in the UI was replayed through the core/CCD loops for 24 synthetic contexts. The read ranges equal the prior mode-3 probe, so changing mode does not resolve the layout/length mismatch. Neither experiment certifies physical buffer bounds or topology.
